arguments.sql:
WITH locations AS (
    SELECT u.Location, COUNT(*) AS post_count
    FROM posts AS p
    JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
      AND u.Location IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY u.Location
), numbered AS (
    SELECT Location, post_count, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Location) - 1) / 12 AS batch
    FROM locations
)
SELECT batch, GROUP_CONCAT(Location || ' (' || post_count || ')', ' | ') AS locations
FROM numbered
GROUP BY batch
ORDER BY batch
